title: AsyncFd accepting AsRawFd violates I/O safety and can lead to UB
author: Darksonn
body_preview: `AsyncFd` accepts `T: AsRawFd` rather than requiring `T: AsFd` (previously discussed in #6984). Because `RawFd` implements `AsRawFd`, safe code can construct `AsyncFd<RawFd>` and close the underlying file descriptor while the `AsyncFd` is still alive.
